Providing and fixing of Single/ Double chamber triple function tamper proof (Both the orifces to be housed in the single chamber) Air valves with Body and cover in Ductile cast iron of grade GGG 40/ 50. All internal parts such as float, shell with appurtenances., all cover bolts of austenitic alloy / SS 304 steel, DN 50 float of HOSTAFLON / SS 304 and gaskers and seals of EPDM. Epoxy powder coating (EP-P) inside and outside colour blue RAL5005. The valves should be designed for all the three functions i.e., 1. Large orifice for venting of large air volumes on start up. 2.
